decisions.reason: The low-cost desk lamp still holds enough early promise and a dedicated page, so the option is worth keeping open while uncertainty remains.
As the flagship pendant luminaire central to the firm’s strategic direction, its option value remains high and abandonment is unlikely.
The marine HMI searchlight remains a niche, non-LED product with only a website mention and little alignment with the firm’s LED direction, so its value is unlikely to be realized.
